<div class="wiki_entry"> 
 <p>How to build plugins manually:</p> 
 <ol>
   
  <li><span class="custom_forecolor_emphasis">Make sure that you don't have any special characters in your Eclipse installation path (this includes whitespaces)<br class="" />&gt;confirmed on MacOS running Ganymede RC2<br class="" /></span></li>
   
  <li>Select &quot;Export&quot; from the context menu of your plugin </li>
   
  <li>Select &quot;Plugin Development&quot;&gt;&quot;Deployable plugins and fragments&quot;</li>
   
  <li>Follow the steps on the wizard. </li>
   
 </ol><br class="" />Automated exporting:<br class="" /><a href="http://www.eclipse.org/articles/Article-PDE-Automation/automation.html">http://www.eclipse.org/articles/Article-PDE-Automation/automation.html</a><br class="" /><br class="" /><a href="http://mojo.codehaus.org/pde-maven-plugin/examples/simple_plugin.html"></a></div>
